heading: Regulatory Infrastructure
body: Sustainable Bitcoin Protocol operates within a multi-jurisdictional regulatory framework designed for institutional compliance. Our verification protocol adheres to international standards and is recognized by leading regulatory bodies across the GCC, EU, and North American markets.

The platform's attestation infrastructure integrates with existing mining infrastructure, enabling capital deployment for sovereign wealth funds, pension and other climate mandated institutions into Bitcoin.
ecosystemHeading: Built within a sovereign-backed institutional ecosystem
